quote: The driver of a vehicle within an intersection intending to turn to the left shall yield the right-of-way to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction which is within the intersection or so close thereto as to constitute an immediate hazard, but such driver, having so yielded and having given a signal when and as required, may make such left turn and the drivers of all other vehicles approaching the intersection from the opposite direction shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle making the left turn.

activation.description: Driver within an intersection intending a left turn
activation.source_clause: within an intersection intending to turn to the left

obligation.description: Yield to opposite-direction immediate hazard, then may turn after yielding and required signal; later opposing drivers yield
obligation.source_clause: shall yield the right-of-way to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction

timing.description: Original opposing approach, ego wait/commit and later response sequence
timing.source_clause: having so yielded and having given a signal when and as required

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original wait, signal, turn and later opposing response are measured without a priority verdict.
Opposing distance, speed and occupancy are measured; legal closeness remains unresolved.
